text: A forger sold a fake Vermeer to Hermann Goering. Han van Meegeren's fake fooled a Dutch museum in nineteen thirty six. During the war, he sold another to Goering. Goering paid with over a hundred looted paintings. After the war, van Meegeren was arrested for treason. His defense: he confessed he was a forger, and painted a new fake in custody. He was sentenced to one year, and died before serving it. Would you have spotted the fake?
